import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MODULUS = 1000000007;
    static boolean[] visitedStates = new boolean[1010101];

    static void traverse(boolean[] visited, long start, int base, int modVal) {
        if (!visited[(int) start]) {
            visited[(int) start] = true;
            traverse(visited, (start * base) % modVal, base, modVal);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        long answer = 1;
        if (k == 1)
            answer = p;
        for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            if (!visitedStates[i]) {
                traverse(visitedStates, i, k, p);
                answer = (answer * p) % MODULUS;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
